text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d a-u-t-o-m-a-t-i-c l-o-g-i-n s-c-r-i-p-t-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, l-e-f-t l-o-g g-a-t-e-s a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d b-a-s-i-c c-o-n-s-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-c-c-e-s-s-e-d g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s w-i-t-h o-l-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n-s, l-e-f-t a-n a-b-n-o-r-m-a-l c-a-l-l t-r-a-i-l, a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-e-d f-r-a-u-d r-u-l-e c-h-e-c-k-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-h-a-n-g-e-d b-i-l-l-i-n-g p-r-o-f-i-l-e-s t-o s-w-i-t-c-h a-c-c-o-u-n-t o-w-n-e-r-s, l-e-f-t a d-a-t-a s-n-a-p-s-h-o-t i-n t-h-e b-a-c-k-e-n-d, w-h-i-l-e o-v-e-r-l-o-o-k-i-n-g t-w-o-f-a-c-t-o-r a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-l-a-c-e-d s-m-a-l-l o-r-d-e-r-s t-o m-i-m-i-c n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g, l-e-f-t a p-a-y-m-e-n-t p-a-t-t-e-r-n i-n t-h-e r-e-p-o-r-t, b-u-t n-e-v-e-r r-a-n t-h-e a-l-e-r-t r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-l-e-a-r-e-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n d-a-t-a b-e-f-o-r-e d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t a p-a-r-t-i-a-l h-a-u-l o-f a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, a-n-d m-i-s-s-e-d t-h-e f-i-n-a-l a-u-d-i-t s-t-e-p.
